name: Breadcrumbs
summary: Shows the current location within a navigation hierarchy.

useWhen: Showing a page location within a hierarchy
Letting people climb back to an ancestor page
avoidWhen: Replacing primary navigation; use HeaderNav or Sidebar

obligations: Expose navigation landmark and current page
Preserve logical reading and focus order

web.html.reason: No framework-free web implementation exists. Use the web.react binding.

behavior: The current item is derived from the final item and is not an activation target
Disabled items are not activation targets
accessibility: Expose a navigation landmark, accessible name, current page, and disabled state
